pages.text: Mom put a coin in Pongi's paw. "Could you buy one loaf of bread from the bakery?"
"I'll go by myself." Pongi went out the door.
Pongi crossed the bridge. She could hear the water beneath her feet.
Something rustled behind her. Pongi looked back. Nobody was there.
She bought bread at the bakery. It was warm, so she held it close.
Another rustle. This time, a tail poked out from behind a tree.
Pongi went behind the tree. Dad was crouching there.
"Dad, what are you doing here?" "Uh... taking a walk."
Pongi took Dad's hand. "Let's go together."
Pongi walked home carrying the bread. Dad walked home empty-handed.
